diseases.name: Early Blight

medications.name: Mancozeb
medications.usage: Apply as per label interval and coverage guidance on affected foliage.
medications.purpose: Protects healthy foliage from further early blight spread.

medications.name: Chlorothalonil
medications.usage: Use label-directed foliar spray schedule with full leaf coverage.
medications.purpose: Reduces lesion expansion and protects new growth.

medications.name: Azoxystrobin
medications.usage: Rotate with non-strobilurin chemistry to avoid resistance pressure.
medications.purpose: Helps suppress active fungal infection.

immediateActions: Remove heavily infected lower leaves.
Avoid overhead irrigation late in the day.
Improve airflow around the crop canopy.
organicSupport: Use mulch to reduce soil splash onto leaves.
Sanitize tools and remove infected debris after harvest.

diseases.name: Late Blight

medications.name: Cymoxanil plus Mancozeb
medications.usage: Use promptly after symptom appearance following label guidance.
medications.purpose: Suppresses active late blight infection and protects healthy tissue.

medications.name: Metalaxyl mix
medications.usage: Use only where label permits and rotate with other chemistries.
medications.purpose: Helps manage oomycete-driven late blight.

immediateActions: Act quickly because late blight can spread fast in cool, wet weather.
Remove severely affected foliage if practical.
Avoid moving through wet fields to limit spread.
organicSupport: Keep leaves dry for as much of the day as possible.
Destroy infected plant residues away from the field.
